page-founders-accelerators-alliance-term: A selective accelerator and founder community. Admitted startups receive investment on a SAFE with a token side letter, and applications are reviewed year-round.
page-founders-accelerators-arbitrum-open: A founder program that pairs online buildathons with in-person Founder House weeks in cities such as London and Singapore. Selected teams get feedback on product, go-to-market and fundraising, and can earn prizes and milestone-based grants.
Mentorship and pitch sessions with ecosystem partners
page-founders-accelerators-base-batches-: An 8-week virtual accelerator for early-stage teams building on Base, ending with a demo day for investors. Cohorts run twice a year.
page-founders-accelerators-kernel-descri: A peer-learning fellowship for people building or researching something new. Kernel offers community and mentorship, not investment.
page-founders-apply-p1: Choose your path and get routed to the most relevant next step.
page-founders-community-ethglobal-descri: Hackathons and events where you can build a prototype in a weekend, get feedback, and meet other builders and sponsors.
page-founders-community-events-descripti: Find upcoming Ethereum conferences, hackathons and local meetups around the world.
page-founders-description: A dedicated hub for entrepreneurs to access programs, mentorship, and visibility across the Ethereum ecosystem, giving founders the support they need at every stage.
page-founders-funding-base-builders-desc: Selective builder grants with product and go-to-market support, plus pre-seed and seed investment from the Base Ecosystem Fund. Integrating Builder Codes is the first step toward grant eligibility.
page-founders-funding-base-builders-high: Weekly product and go-to-market office hours
page-founders-funding-esp-applicants-des: Grants and non-financial support for open-source, non-commercial work that benefits Ethereum. Browse the Wishlist and RFPs, or book office hours if you're not sure where your project fits.
page-founders-funding-esp-applicants-hig: Wishlist and RFP items to apply for
page-founders-funding-uniswap-descriptio: Uniswap Foundation grants for protocols, tooling and research, Unichain grants for DeFi and infrastructure projects, and audit subsidies for Uniswap v4 hooks.
page-founders-last-checked: Program details were last checked in October 2026. Always confirm terms and deadlines with the program before applying.
page-founders-metadata-description: Funding, grants, accelerators and mentorship for founders building on Ethereum. Find the programs that support your startup from idea to growth.
page-founders-rfpsearch-p: Search grants, bounties, hackathons and requests for proposals across the Ethereum ecosystem. Check the requirements and apply directly with each program.
page-founders-succeed-p1: You don't have to build alone, this ecosystem has your back.
page-founders-technical-alchemy-descript: Infrastructure credits and engineering support for teams building onchain, whether bootstrapped, venture-backed or in an accelerator. These are service credits, not cash funding.
page-founders-technical-arbitrum-descrip: Active Arbitrum Foundation programs subsidise third-party smart contract audits and sponsor gas fees for early-stage teams building on Arbitrum.
